_comment: Canonical places absent from the cadaei shapefile set, patched in by
pipeline/03_build_gazetteer.py. Coordinates are positioned relative to
neighbouring places that ARE in the source data, so they stay consistent
with the rest of the map rather than with any external map's projection.
Set "confirmed": false for anything whose position is inferred.

places.name: Casterly Rock
places.positioning: Immediately north of Lannisport (7.365, 5.222), which the source data does include; the Rock overlooks the city and the Sunset Sea.

places.name: Bear Island
places.positioning: Centroid of the Bear Island polygon in the source Islands layer; the Mormont keep is the island's only settlement.
